The truth is, I didn't change just for physical reasons. I changed because I was constantly surrounded by the wrong people.

My habits became unhealthy. My mindset became negative. And slowly, I started becoming someone I didn't recognize. And I knew if I didn't do something, I'd stay stuck.

So I decided to take control. To let go of the people and situations that were dragging me down. To create a space where I could grow and feel proud of who I was becoming.

Your environment is everything. Who you choose to surround yourself with shapes your mindset, your actions, and your future.

So choose people who make you better not bitter.

Everyone asks how I did it, how I stayed so consistent, how I kept going when it got hard, how I changed my entire body in just 6 months.

The truth? It wasn't a secret workout or some perfect diet.
It was my mindset.

Once I committed mentally to showing up even on the hard days, to choosing discipline over motivation, to not giving up when progress felt slow, everything started to change.

When your mind is strong, your actions follow.
And when you stay consistent, your life transforms not just your body.

📍 Jan 1 – 148.8 lbs / 67.5 kg
📍 Jul 1 – 130.7 lbs / 59.3 kg
Total loss: 18.1 lbs / 8.2 kg 

What worked for me:
• Strength training 3–5x/week
• 10K steps/day + 15–25 min cardio after lifts
• 300–500 cal deficit depending on the goal
• 80/20 nutrition (progress > perfection)
• 100g+ protein daily
• 2–3L of water daily

Your mindset will always be your greatest strength. 💭💪
